decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the product feed, I narrowed my consideration set to actual backpacks with high user ratings and positive reviews. The HIKPRO 20L Packable Backpack (prod_backpacks_006) is the strongest option, offering a 4.7 rating at a very affordable price of $17.99. It is highly praised for being lightweight and durable, making it an excellent value compared to the more specialized or expensive options like the USGI Military ALICE pack ($339.99) or the OutdoorMaster boot bag ($57.99). Although the feed contained many non-backpack items like camping stoves and wood augers, the presence of the HIKPRO bag provided a clear and high-value purchase option.
